name: Molara
summary: A dental practice app: chair schedule, patient flow board, tooth charts, bills and supplies
about: An eight-page app for running a dental clinic, from today's patients to bills and supplies. It has a drag-and-drop schedule by chair or by week, a live patient flow board, a clickable tooth chart on every patient record, treatment plans with a price list, part payments and a supplies store with reorders.
how: Open Today: chair timers tick live and the flow board shows who is booked, waiting, in the chair or at billing
Drag a patient card to the next stage, or press its arrow for a Move to… menu; Billing raises the bill
Open Appointments, switch Day or Week and drag a booking to another chair, day or time
Click a booking for quick actions: 15 minutes later, next day, SMS reminder or cancel
Open a patient and click any tooth on the chart to mark a cavity, filling, crown, root canal or missing tooth
Tick treatment-plan steps, take part payments in Billing and switch 7D, 30D or 12M on the chart
Use or restock supplies, reorder everything that is low and reset demo data in Settings
